page.overview:
Who is Alkhor?

Alkhor, called "Alkhor the Defiler," the "Tide of Pestilence" and the "Sluglord," was a Daemon Prince of Nurgle who nearly succeeded in bringing his master into the mortal world and who corrupted large parts of the forest of Athel Loren.

As a mortal, Alkhor was a young physician who had been arrested for experimental work and left to die in a lightless dungeon, before he received his first mutation in the form of a talking boil that manifested in his armpit. Since then, his service to Nurgle had proved so exemplary that he had ascended to become a Daemon Prince of the Plague Lord.

Alkhor fought at the Battle of the Fist of Gron against Snorri Whitebeard and Prince Malekith in an alliance with the Tzeentchian Daemon Prince Htarken. The Daemon led hordes of mutated tribesmen of the north, tallymen of Nurgle and other daemonic beasts, but was defeated by the united prowess of the Dwarf high king and the prince of Nagarythe after Htarken betrayed him. Cursing his traitorous ally, Alkhor retreated after being burned by Malekith's Dragon mount, and was hunted by the High Elven Prince Aestar Eltanin.

Eltanin pursued the Daemon Prince on his Great Eagle to the forest of Athel Loren, where Alkhor's power was finally exhausted and he crashed. Even as he fell, the Daemon Prince managed to kill the avian mount of Eltanin, causing him to fall with him. The pair fought each other in the boughs of the forest, despite their wounds, until the forest spirits of Athel Loren arrived under the leadership of Drycha. Seeing them both as intruders, the Dryad sealed them both beneath a dolmen in a circle of waystones, despite Eltanin's protests. Alkhor, for his part, consumed the soul of the High Elf and begat a plan to free himself and use the connection of his prison to the forest to provide Nurgle with a gift of extraordinary magnitude.
